hook: Node finally ships SQLite built in.

beats.say: On the twenty-sixth of November, Node twenty-seven alpha shipped with a one-line change: node sqlite, mark as stable.
The module arrived in version twenty-two point five, and was a release candidate since twenty-five point seven and twenty-four point fifteen.
Watch the number trap: plain numbers go in as floats, so store text IDs as strings, and use a big integer when you need one.
